note: Actual speed moves toward the ordered speed. Ordered speed is what movement energy pays for (1 per speed point, including a half point). These bands are a clean-room fit to observed spool-up times. Each band adds gainHundredths once per overTicks, and the fraction divides the band width exactly, so the boundary is reached on a tick with a zero remainder. Deceleration is 110 hundredths per 30 ticks (1.1 speed per second) for both hulls. A hull that is not listed keeps the per-order acceleration clamp and has no separate actual speed.

K-D7.note: From rest, about 10 / 18.5 / 28 / 41 / 57 / 76 s to speeds 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30, and 31 at 79 s.
